events.title: Demo 1.1.2 Patch Notes
events.summary: Hello, small patch today!Welcome to everyone who's been playing as a result of Next Fest, I really appreciate every one of you trying out my little game.Very small fix for today.Critical Hit Chance has been fixed so it multiplies the original Critical Hit value instead of adding to it.Default Critical Hit Chance has been increased from 0.075 to 0.15 to compensateThis means that Critical Hit will be slightly less effective but will actually work as intended. events.title: Demo V1.1.1 Patch Notes
events.summary: Hello!This is a small update with a few changes.Controller Rumble has been added with support for most controllers.Ultrawide Resolution support has been added.Text Scroll background image has been changed to reflect new key art.Some particle effects have a new appearance.Misc bug fixesKnown Issues:Steam Deck rumble doesn't work quite as intended right now. This may also apply to other Valve hardware.Performance struggles a bit particularly on Steam Deck in later waves depending on buffs.

events.title: The Devil's Sanctum Demo is now available!
